name: CrediWise - Use the right card, every time.
tagline: A browser extension that picks the best credit card at checkout and tracks what you saved.
problem: People guess which card earns the most rewards at each checkout.
solution: Detects checkout pages, recommends the card with the best rate and offers, and shows savings and AI insights.
demo_moment: Team-described: reach a checkout and see the recommendation pop up.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Capital One] $250 Amazon Gift Card” among 112 submissions.
Acts in the checkout flow users already use.

lessons: Meet the decision where it happens: the checkout page.
